name: intent
description: Help product managers write and publish intents without touching git — /intent-create interviews you and opens an issue, /intent-sync publishes your Word edits (warning first if the intent changed on GitHub), /intent-refresh rebuilds your Word file from GitHub, /intent-promote moves the intent to Ready for planning, and /intent-revoke takes it back to Create and removes its lock; planning locks an intent with lock.yaml in the-marmack/intents.
